description.en: RunUnlockSkillEx(_chr, _skill, 30, 30, "J_08", 0, _msg): teaches a Special Move with a chosen message. The BGM is stopped with a fade of 30, the function waits 30 frames, and the jingle J_08 plays while the message shows. No shipped script calls it directly.
Parameter ID of the character, e.g. "para_cp0008".
Message ID to show instead of the default one.
